---
title: "Sensitive Research: Positionality and Reflexivity In Fragile and Violence-Affected Contexts"
subtitle: "RC42 session · XXI ISA World Congress of Sociology, Gwangju 2027"
date: 2027-07-04
author:
  - "Sandra Rios Oyola"
categories: [Research Methods, Reflexivity]
---

This panel explores how researchers' positionality and reflexivity function within fieldwork conducted in violence-affected environments. The session examines qualitative re-approaches that address human rights violations and examines how researcher positioning influences research design, methodology, and interpretation. The discussion integrates intersectional frameworks with emotion-based analysis to advance understanding of situated knowledge and epistemological reflexivity as methodological concerns.

**Organizer(s)/Chair(s):**

- Sandra Rios Oyola, University of Louvain, Belgium

**Host committee(s):** RC42 Social Psychology; TG02 Conflict Transformations and Peacebuilding
